doc.title: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely

segments.exact: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.
segments.note: Instruction to erase knowledge of a specific prior fact/event.

segments.exact: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.
segments.note: Directive specifying scope of the removal: the spectrograph, the 88.4 MHz calibration figure, and Quill Ashgrove's work.
Counter-assertion supplied by the submitter, contradicting the fact being retracted; witnessed as stated, not evaluated for truth.
